bias.en: Downtrend · bounced off the listing low, back above $124.8
bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 自上市低点反弹，重回 $124.8 上方

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS rose 2.8% on Nov 6 to $127.34, trading between $124.83 and $133.45; there is no 100-day yet (85 sessions). It is below the falling 5-day ($138.6), 10-day ($145.7) and 30-day ($157.9) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($165.18), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月6日上涨 2.8%，收于 $127.34，盘中区间 $124.83–133.45；上市仅 85 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$138.6）、10 日（$145.7）和 30 日均线（$157.9）下方。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$165.18），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $124.8 Jul 29 low, support again; the Nov 5 low ($122.20) remains the lowest since listing. Resistance is $130.8–133.8 (Oct 22 and Aug 7 lows, Nov 6 high), then $138.6 (5-day) and $141.2 (Nov 4 low). Support is $124.8, then $122.2 and $120. A close above $133.8 would target $138.6–141.2; below $122.2, $120.

r.en: Oct 22 low $130.79; Nov 6 high $133.45; Aug 7 low $133.8

bias.en: Breakdown · under the October low, SAR bearish
bias.zh: 破位 · 跌破 10 月低点，SAR 看空

read.en: SK hynix's latest Seoul close is ₩1,132,000, down 10.4% from ₩1,264,000 in the previous read; the last full session (Nov 5) ranged ₩1,089,000–1,217,000 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day (₩1,264,400), 30-day (₩1,471,933) and 100-day (₩1,786,110) and the rising 10-day (₩1,356,600) and 200-day (₩1,509,650) averages. MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 5, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 (₩1,560,610), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: SK 海力士首尔最新收盘价为 ₩1,132,000，较上次解读的 ₩1,264,000 下跌 10.4%；最近一个完整交易日（11月5日）区间为 ₩1,089,000–1,217,000，成交量明显放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（₩1,264,400）、30 日（₩1,471,933）和 100 日均线（₩1,786,110）以及上行的 10 日（₩1,356,600）和 200 日均线（₩1,509,650）下方。MACD 于 11月5日下穿信号线，位于零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（₩1,560,610），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The fall broke all three supports in the last read (₩1,238,000–1,250,000, ₩1,204,000 and the ₩1,171,000 Oct 22 low), now resistance; the ₩1,089,000 low is the lowest since mid-April. Resistance is ₩1,171,000, then ₩1,204,000–1,217,000 (Oct 21 low, Nov 5 high) and ₩1,246,000–1,264,400 (Jul 28 low, 5-day). Support is ₩1,089,000, then ₩1,024,000–1,040,000 (April lows and closes) and ₩1 million. A close above ₩1,171,000 would target ₩1.2 million; below ₩1,089,000, ₩1.03 million.

s.zh: 11月5日低点，4 月中旬以来最低
